description: Find internal link opportunities from a source page to required supplied target pages. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase to analyze for this workflow. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

max_suggestions.description: Maximum number of internal-link suggestions to return. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 20. Default: 8.

source_markdown.description: Source page content as Markdown instead of fetching source_url; supply this or source_url. Type: String. Minimum: 80 characters. Maximum: 50000 characters. Optional; no client default.

source_url.description: Accessible source page URL to inspect for link opportunities; supply this or source_markdown. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

target_pages.description: Candidate internal pages from a sitemap, CMS, crawler, Search Console or a prior sitemap audit. The handler requires 1-50 entries even though this wire field is optional; omitting it returns setup guidance without an API request. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 50 items. Optional; no client default.

items.description: One candidate internal page with its supplied title and optional relevance evidence. Type: Object. Required.

description.description: Short summary of this supplied page; this is input evidence, not a request to generate a meta description. Type: String. Maximum: 500 characters. Optional; no client default.

keywords.description: Search phrases to evaluate or associate with the supplied page. Type: Array. Maximum: 12 items. Default: [].

items.description: One search keyword or phrase, not a comma-separated list. Type: String. Required.

title.description: Title of the supplied page or work item, used as its human-readable label. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 180 characters. Required.

url.description: Absolute URL identifying a supplied internal-link candidate page; this field does not request a page fetch. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

name: agentseo_content_internal_links
title: AgentSEO Content Internal Links
